title: LoRaTap: support for v1 encapsulation
description:
This MR adds support for additional header fields for LoRaTap encapsulation as defined in https://github.com/alpov/LoRaTap, pull request to the original repo with specification here https://github.com/eriknl/LoRaTap/pull/3.

List of major changes:
* fixed support for unknown LoRaTap header versions using lt_length instead of current_offset (this bug causes failure of v1 header dissecting in master)
* added support to LoRaTap encapsulation v1
* added N/A for RSSI == 255
* added private LoRa syncword 0x12
* fixed wrong SNR values in snr_base_custom()
* added payload display

Wireshark pcap files for testing are available here: https://github.com/alpov/LoRaTap/tree/testfiles. Malformed packets in these test files are caused by bugs in the LoRaWAN dissector which will be solved in a separate merge request.
